task: Matrix Report: Sticky Headers, Sorting, and Optimization

key_achievements: Implemented Sticky Headers for multi-row thead with correct offsets.
Added interactive sorting for all columns (Name, Demand, Pending, and 7 Action types).
Optimized data fetching using AbortController to prevent redundant and overlapping requests.
Fixed UI layout to use a full-screen height scrollable container, preventing body-level scrolling issues.
Improved z-index management for sticky elements (Left column + Top headers).
